## 1) Beta-Diversität: Ordination (NMDS)

```{r}
# Rarefaction – auf gleiche Sequenztiefe normalisieren
set.seed(42)
ps_rare <- rarefy_even_depth(ps, sample.size = min(sample_sums(ps)),
                              rngseed = 42, replace = FALSE)
cat("Reads pro Sample nach Rarefaction:", min(sample_sums(ps_rare)), "\n")
cat("ASVs nach Rarefaction:", ntaxa(ps_rare), "\n")

# Dann nochmal OTU-Matrix
otu_mat_rare <- t(as.matrix(otu_table(ps_rare)))
dist_bc_rare <- vegdist(otu_mat_rare, method = "bray")
summary(as.vector(dist_bc_rare))
# Median =1 =>Schlecht
```
```{r}
otu_hell <- decostand(otu_mat, method = "hellinger")
dist_hell <- dist(otu_hell, method = "euclidean")
summary(as.vector(dist_hell))

#1.4 ist auch wenig
```

```{r}
# ASVs pro Lauf (nur wo Reads > 0)
for (run in c("EC24_245", "3XX", "Popa", "Buse")) {
  ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps, sequencing_run == run)
  ps_sub <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_sub) > 0, ps_sub)
  cat(run, ":", ntaxa(ps_sub), "ASVs\n")
}

# Überlapp zwischen Läufen
asvs_ec24 <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(ps, sequencing_run == "EC24_245")) > 0, ps))
asvs_3xx  <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(ps, sequencing_run == "3XX")) > 0, ps))
asvs_buse <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(ps, sequencing_run == "Buse")) > 0, ps))
asvs_popa <- taxa_names(prune_taxa(taxa_sums(subset_samples(ps, sequencing_run == "Popa")) > 0, ps))

cat("\nÜberlapp EC24 & 3XX:", length(intersect(asvs_ec24, asvs_3xx)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp EC24 & Buse:", length(intersect(asvs_ec24, asvs_buse)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp 3XX & Buse:", length(intersect(asvs_3xx, asvs_buse)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp alle 4:", length(Reduce(intersect, list(asvs_ec24, asvs_3xx, asvs_buse, asvs_popa))), "\n")
```

ASVs müssen geclustert werden, sonst gibt es keine sinnvolle NMDS 

## VSearch vorbereiten: ASV to OTU clustering for NMDS


## Prüfen, ob Clustering erfolgreich war

```{r}
# ── Schritt 1: .uc Datei einlesen ─────────────────────────────────────────────
uc <- read.table(file.path(base_path, "Data/Final/otus.uc"),
                 sep = "\t", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Nur Hit-Zeilen (H) und Seed-Zeilen (S) behalten
uc_hits <- uc[uc$V1 %in% c("H", "S"), c("V1", "V9", "V10")]
colnames(uc_hits) <- c("type", "asv", "otu")

# Size-Tag entfernen
uc_hits$asv_clean <- gsub(";size=.*$", "", uc_hits$asv)
uc_hits$otu_clean <- gsub(";size=.*$", "", uc_hits$otu)

# Für S-Zeilen (Seeds) ist OTU = ASV
uc_hits$otu_clean[uc_hits$type == "S"] <- uc_hits$asv_clean[uc_hits$type == "S"]

cat("ASVs gemappt:", nrow(uc_hits), "\n")
cat("OTUs gesamt:", length(unique(uc_hits$otu_clean)), "\n")

# ── Schritt 2: OTU-Tabelle erstellen ──────────────────────────────────────────
# ASV-Matrix aus phyloseq (Samples × ASVs)
asv_mat <- as.matrix(t(otu_table(ps)))
colnames(asv_mat) <- gsub("^X", "", colnames(asv_mat))

# Mapping: Sequenz → OTU-Centroid
asv_to_otu <- setNames(uc_hits$otu_clean, uc_hits$asv_clean)

# Nur gematchte ASVs
shared <- intersect(colnames(asv_mat), names(asv_to_otu))
cat("Matches:", length(shared), "\n") #10833

# OTU-Tabelle durch Summierung
otu_mat_new <- t(rowsum(t(asv_mat[, shared]),
                         group = asv_to_otu[shared],
                         na.rm = TRUE))

cat("OTU-Tabelle:", nrow(otu_mat_new), "Samples ×", ncol(otu_mat_new), "OTUs\n")

# ── Schritt 3: Distanzmatrix prüfen ───────────────────────────────────────────
dist_otu <- vegdist(otu_mat_new, method = "bray")
summary(as.vector(dist_otu))

# OTU-Overlap zwischen Läufen
meta_df_clean <- data.frame(sample_data(ps)) %>% rownames_to_column("sample")

for (run in c("EC24_245", "3XX", "Popa", "Buse")) {
  samples <- meta_df_clean$sample[meta_df_clean$sequencing_run == run]
  samples <- gsub("^X", "", samples)
  otus <- colnames(otu_mat_new)[colSums(otu_mat_new[samples, ]) > 0]
  cat(run, ":", length(otus), "OTUs\n")
}

# OTUs pro Lauf als Liste
otus_per_run <- list()
for (run in c("EC24_245", "3XX", "Popa", "Buse")) {
  samples <- meta_df_clean$sample[meta_df_clean$sequencing_run == run]
  samples <- gsub("^X", "", samples)
  otus_per_run[[run]] <- colnames(otu_mat_new)[colSums(otu_mat_new[samples, ]) > 0]
}

# Paarweiser Overlap
cat("Überlapp EC24 & 3XX:", length(intersect(otus_per_run$EC24_245, otus_per_run$`3XX`)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp EC24 & Buse:", length(intersect(otus_per_run$EC24_245, otus_per_run$Buse)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp 3XX & Buse:", length(intersect(otus_per_run$`3XX`, otus_per_run$Buse)), "\n")
cat("Überlapp alle 4:", length(Reduce(intersect, otus_per_run)), "\n")
```

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}

# ── Schritt 4: NMDS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set.seed(123)
ord_otu <- metaMDS(otu_mat_new, distance = "bray", k = 2, trymax = 100)
cat("Stress:", round(ord_otu$stress, 4), "\n")

# ── Schritt 5: Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
nmds_df <- data.frame(
  NMDS1  = ord_otu$points[, 1],
  NMDS2  = ord_otu$points[, 2],
  sample = rownames(ord_otu$points)) %>%
  left_join(data.frame(sample_data(ps)) %>%
              rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
              mutate(sample = gsub("^X", "", sample)) %>%
              dplyr::select(sample, beetle_species, family),
            by = "sample")


# Farben & Reihenfolge (konsistent mit beetle_traits.qmd)
family_colors <- c(
  "Carabidae"     = "#2C7BB6",
  "Buprestidae"   = "#A63603",
  "Tenebrionidae" = "#1A9641",
  "Cerambycidae"  = "#FDAE61",
  "Curculionidae" = "#7B3294"
)

species_order <- c(
  "Anthaxia_fulgurans", "Anthaxia_quadripunctata",
  "Chrysobothris_affinis", "Buprestis_haemorrhoidalis",
  "Bolitophagus_reticulatus",
  "Rhagium_bifasciatum", "Rhagium_inquisitor", "Rhagium_mordax",
  "Grammoptera_ruficornis", "Pachytodes_cerambyciformis",
  "Rutpela_maculata", "Stenurella_melanura",
  "Ips_typographus",
  "Pterostichus_aethiops"
)

cols <- setNames(pal_d3("category20")(14), species_order)

ggplot(nmds_df, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = beetle_species, shape = family)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = beetle_species), 
               level = 0.95, linewidth = 0.4,
               linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols, drop = FALSE,
                     labels = function(x) gsub("_", " ", x)) +  # Unterstriche → Leerzeichen
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 18, 8)) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf,
           label = paste0("Stress = ", round(ord_otu$stress, 4)),
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "NMDS (Bray-Curtis, OTU-level)",
       color = "Beetle species", shape = "Family") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "vertical") +
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 4, byrow = TRUE,
                              override.aes = list(size = 3)),
         shape = guide_legend(nrow = 1))


ggsave(file.path(base_path, "Results/Figures/NMDS_OTU.pdf"),
       width = 12, height = 7, bg = "white")
```

## 2) PERMANOVA: Käferart, Familie, Traits

```{r}
#| label: permanova

meta <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps))

# Beetle traits zu Metadaten hinzufügen
meta <- meta %>%
  left_join(beetles[, c("species", "gilde", "nahrung", "wald",
                         "niche_decay_num", "body_length",
                         "hairiness_total", "wing_load")],
            by = c("beetle_species" = "species"))

# ── PERMANOVA 1: Käferart ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
perm_species <- adonis2(dist_bc ~ beetle_species, data = meta,
                        permutations = 999)
cat("PERMANOVA ~ beetle_species:\n")
print(perm_species)

# ── PERMANOVA 2: Familie (Phylogenie-Proxy) ───────────────────────────────────
perm_family <- adonis2(dist_bc ~ family, data = meta,
                       permutations = 999)
cat("\nPERMANOVA ~ family:\n")
print(perm_family)

# ── PERMANOVA 3: Funktionelle Traits ─────────────────────────────────────────
perm_traits <- adonis2(dist_bc ~ gilde + nahrung + wald +
                                  niche_decay_num + body_length +
                                  hairiness_total + wing_load,
                       data = meta, permutations = 999, na.action = na.omit)
cat("\nPERMANOVA ~ functional traits:\n")
print(perm_traits)

# ── PERMANOVA 4: Multifaktoriell (Phylogenie + Traits) ───────────────────────
perm_multi <- adonis2(dist_bc ~ family + gilde + nahrung + wald +
                                 niche_decay_num + body_length +
                                 hairiness_total + wing_load,
                      data = meta, permutations = 999, na.action = na.omit)
cat("\nMultifaktorielle PERMANOVA:\n")
print(perm_multi)
```

## 8) Indicator Species

```{r}
#| label: indicator-species

# OTU presence/absence Matrix (Samples × ASVs)
otu_pa <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps))
otu_pa[otu_pa > 0] <- 1
otu_pa <- t(otu_pa)  # Samples × ASVs

group <- sample_data(ps)$beetle_species

# Indicator species Analyse
indval_result <- multipatt(
  otu_pa,
  group,
  func    = "IndVal.g",
  control = how(nperm = 999)
)

summary(indval_result, alpha = 0.05)

# Als DataFrame
indval_df <- as.data.frame(indval_result$sign) %>%
  rownames_to_column("ASV") %>%
  filter(p.value <= 0.05)

# Taxonomie hinzufügen
indval_taxa <- indval_df %>%
  left_join(tax_df[, c("ASV", "Genus_clean", "Species", "Family")],
            by = "ASV")

cat("Signifikante Indicator ASVs:", nrow(indval_taxa), "\n")
head(indval_taxa)
```

## 9) Core Mycobiome

```{r}
#| label: core-mycobiome

# Core: ASVs die in >= 70% der Proben einer Art vorkommen
core_per_species <- lapply(species_order, function(sp) {
  ps_sub <- subset_samples(ps, beetle_species == sp)
  if (nsamples(ps_sub) < 2) return(NULL)

  otu_sub <- as.matrix(otu_table(ps_sub))
  prevalence <- rowSums(otu_sub > 0) / nsamples(ps_sub)
  core_asvs <- names(prevalence[prevalence >= 0.7])

  data.frame(
    beetle_species = sp,
    ASV            = core_asvs,
    prevalence     = prevalence[core_asvs]
  )
})

core_df <- bind_rows(core_per_species)
cat("Core ASVs gesamt:", nrow(core_df), "\n")

core_summary <- core_df %>%
  dplyr::count(beetle_species) %>%
  mutate(beetle_species = factor(beetle_species, levels = species_order))

ggplot(core_summary, aes(x = beetle_species, y = n,
                          fill = beetle_species)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = species_order) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Number of core ASVs",
       title = "Core mycobiome size per beetle species (prevalence ≥ 70%)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"),
        legend.position = "none")

ggsave(file.path(base_path, "Results/Figures/core_mycobiome.pdf"),
       width = 10, height = 6)
```

## 10) Overlap zwischen Arten (UpSet + Jaccard)

```{r}
#| label: overlap

# Liste: Käferart → Core ASVs
otu_lists <- core_df %>%
  group_by(beetle_species) %>%
  summarise(asvs = list(unique(ASV)), .groups = "drop")
otu_list <- setNames(otu_lists$asvs, otu_lists$beetle_species)

# UpSet Plot
ups_data <- fromList(otu_list)
upset(ups_data, nsets = length(otu_list), order.by = "freq",
      sets.x.label = "Core ASV overlap")

# Jaccard Heatmap
jacc <- vegdist(t(as.matrix(do.call(rbind,
  lapply(names(otu_list), function(sp) {
    all_asvs <- unique(unlist(otu_list))
    as.integer(all_asvs %in% otu_list[[sp]])
  })))), method = "jaccard")

rownames(as.matrix(jacc)) <- names(otu_list)
jac_long <- melt(1 - as.matrix(jacc))

ggplot(jac_long, aes(Var1, Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Jaccard similarity",
       title = "Core mycobiome overlap between beetle species") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, face = "italic"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic"))

ggsave(file.path(base_path, "Results/Figures/jaccard_heatmap.pdf"),
       width = 10, height = 8)
```
